_comment: Single source of truth for the post-model crash-signature gate. Read by app.py (profiles.py) and compiled into the firmware by tools/gen_firmware_profiles.py. Do not edit 'production': it is the thesis taxonomy (phase2/label_v2.py) and tests/test_profiles.py pins it. 'demo_rc' is written only by analysis/rc_demo_profile.py --write-profile from measured RC-car data.

production.description: Operating taxonomy. Derived from 27,711 verified VZCrash full-size vehicle crashes (Phase 2).

provenance.peak_band: 2.0-7.0 g contains 99.93% of 27,711 VZCrash crash-event peaks (0.00% below 2 g, 0.07% at or above 7 g)
provenance.duration_window: 40-250 ms: 17.2% of crash events fall below 40 ms, 1.8% above 250 ms (81.0% inside)
provenance.severe_impulse: 0.959 g.s = 85th percentile of event impulse over the 22,433 signature-matching VZCrash crashes; delta-v = 0.959 x 9.80665 = 9.40 m/s (33.9 km/h)

demo_rc.description: Scaled demonstration configuration for the radio-controlled demonstrator. NOT the operating taxonomy; no thesis performance figure derives from it. See DEMO_PROFILE.md.
